### Shaonlee Patranabis

Economic geographer and post-doctoral researcher at [Imago](https://imago.liverpool.ac.uk), University of Liverpool. I work with satellite imagery and spatial analysis, with a particular interest in cities in the Global South.

My PhD at LSE examined how colonial institutions and contemporary mortgage markets shape spatial inequality and urban development in India.

I love making maps, petting cats, and exploring cities.
